text: Maria told Tom that she was leaving.
ir: (assert (e1 tell :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :iobj (m2 Tom :propn) :comp (e2 leave :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m3 she :pron :ref m1))))
notes: she: Tom (m2) excluded by agreement (Tom is masculine). Only Maria remains. Spec silent on the role of the addressee of tell + that-clause; annotated :iobj (recipient, as in 'tell Tom the news').

text: The dog wagged its tail.
ir: (assert (e1 wag :tense past :subj (m1 dog :det the) :obj (m2 tail :poss (m3 it :pron :ref m1))))
notes: its: possessive, exempt from binding, so the subject dog is allowed. tail (m2) excluded because it contains the pronoun (an NP cannot be its own possessor; spec silent, generator convention).

text: Tom saw him in the mirror.
ir: (assert (e1 see :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obj (m2 he :pron :ref none) :obl-in (m3 mirror :det the)))
notes: him: Tom excluded by binding (non-reflexive object cannot refer to the subject of its own clause); mirror excluded by agreement (non-human). No candidate: :ref none.

text: Maria hurt herself on the stairs.
ir: (assert (e1 hurt :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 she :pron :refl :ref m1) :obl-on (m3 stair :det the :num pl)))
notes: herself: reflexive refers to the subject of its own clause (Maria). stairs excluded (reflexive binding; also plural, non-human). 'hurt' with a 3sg subject and no -s is past.

text: The children finished their homework before dinner.
ir: (assert (e1 finish :tense past :subj (m1 child :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 homework :poss (m3 they :pron :ref m1)) :obl-before (m4 dinner)))
notes: their: possessive, exempt from binding. homework excluded (singular; contains the pronoun); dinner excluded (singular). Only the plural children remain.

text: The king thanked the queen because she had saved the castle.
ir: (assert (e1 thank :tense past :subj (m1 king :det the) :obj (m2 queen :det the) :cause (e2 save :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 she :pron :ref m2) :obj (m4 castle :det the))))
notes: she: king excluded by agreement (lexically masculine); castle excluded (non-human). Only queen.

text: The farmer sold the cow because it was old.
ir: (assert (e1 sell :tense past :subj (m1 farmer :det the) :obj (m2 cow :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m2) :attr old)))
notes: it: farmer excluded by agreement (human). Only cow.

text: Sam lent the twins his bicycle.
ir: (assert (e1 lend :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :iobj (m2 twin :det the :num pl) :obj (m3 bicycle :poss (m4 he :pron :ref m1))))
notes: his: possessive, exempt from binding, so subject Sam (unknown gender, compatible with he) is allowed. twins excluded (plural); bicycle excluded (non-human; contains the pronoun).

text: Robin lost her keys.
ir: (assert (e1 lose :tense past :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :obj (m2 key :num pl :poss (m3 she :pron :ref m1))))
notes: her: possessive, exempt from binding. Robin has unknown gender, so compatible with she. keys excluded (plural, non-human, contains the pronoun).

text: The woman gave the man her umbrella.
ir: (assert (e1 give :tense past :subj (m1 woman :det the) :iobj (m2 man :det the) :obj (m3 umbrella :poss (m4 she :pron :ref m1))))
notes: her: man excluded by agreement (masculine); umbrella excluded (non-human, contains the pronoun). Possessive is exempt from binding, so the subject woman is allowed.

text: The teacher praised the students because they had worked hard.
ir: (assert (e1 praise :tense past :subj (m1 teacher :det the) :obj (m2 student :det the :num pl) :cause (e2 work :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m2) :adv hard)))
notes: they: teacher excluded by number (singular). Only students.

text: Alex said that he would call Maria.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 Alex :propn) :comp (e2 call :mod would :subj (m2 he :pron :ref m1) :obj (m3 Maria :propn))))
notes: he: Maria excluded by agreement (feminine) and by binding (a pronoun subject cannot refer to a name inside its own clause). Alex has unknown gender, compatible with he.

text: He said that Tom had left.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 he :pron :ref none) :comp (e2 leave :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m2 Tom :propn))))
notes: he: Tom excluded by binding rule 2 (a pronoun subject cannot refer to a name inside its own clause; the comp clause is inside the clause of 'he'). No candidate: :ref none.

text: Maria saw her at the station.
ir: (assert (e1 see :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 she :pron :ref none) :obl-at (m3 station :det the)))
notes: her: Maria excluded by binding (object pronoun cannot refer to the subject of its own clause); station excluded (non-human). :ref none.

text: The cat chased the mice until they escaped.
ir: (assert (e1 chase :tense past :subj (m1 cat :det the) :obj (m2 mouse :det the :num pl) :until (e2 escape :tense past :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m2))))
notes: they: cat excluded by number (singular). Only mice.

text: Maria bought a lamp because it was cheap.
ir: (assert (e1 buy :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 lamp :det a) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m2) :attr cheap)))
notes: it: Maria excluded by agreement (human). Only lamp.

text: Every boy loves his mother.
ir: (assert (e1 love :tense pres :subj (m1 boy :det every) :obj (m2 mother :poss (m3 he :pron :ref m1))))
notes: his: quantified antecedent allowed (§6). mother excluded by agreement (feminine) and because it contains the pronoun. Possessive exempt from binding.

text: The boys have hurt themselves.
ir: (assert (e1 hurt :tense pres :aspect perf :subj (m1 boy :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 they :pron :refl :ref m1)))
notes: themselves: reflexive refers to the subject of its own clause.

text: Maria told Tom that he needed rest.
ir: (assert (e1 tell :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :iobj (m2 Tom :propn) :comp (e2 need :tense past :subj (m3 he :pron :ref m2) :obj (m4 rest))))
notes: he: Maria excluded by agreement (feminine); rest excluded (non-human). Only Tom. Addressee of tell + that-clause annotated :iobj (spec silent).

text: No girl forgot her ticket.
ir: (assert (e1 forget :tense past :subj (m1 girl :det no) :obj (m2 ticket :poss (m3 she :pron :ref m1))))
notes: her: quantified antecedent 'no girl' allowed (§6); possessive exempt from binding. ticket excluded (non-human, contains the pronoun).

text: Tom met Maria and her sister.
ir: (assert (e1 meet :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obj (and (m2 Maria :propn) (m3 sister :poss (m4 she :pron :ref m2)))))
notes: her: Tom excluded by agreement (masculine); sister excluded because it contains the pronoun. Only Maria.

text: The birds built their nest quickly.
ir: (assert (e1 build :tense past :subj (m1 bird :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 nest :poss (m3 they :pron :ref m1)) :adv quickly))
notes: their: nest excluded (singular, contains the pronoun). Possessive exempt from binding, so the subject birds is allowed.

text: If the students fail, they will repeat the course.
ir: (assert (e1 repeat :tense fut :subj (m1 they :pron :ref m3) :obj (m2 course :det the) :condition (e2 fail :tense pres :subj (m3 student :det the :num pl))))
notes: they: course excluded (singular). students is in the if-clause, not inside the pronoun's own clause, so rule 2 does not apply.

text: The old man fed the pigeons, and they flew away.
ir: (assert (and (e1 feed :tense past :subj (m1 man :det the :adj old) :obj (m2 pigeon :det the :num pl)) (e2 fly :tense past :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m2) :adv away)))
notes: they: man excluded by number. Only pigeons. 'away' treated as an adverb.

text: Robin painted the fence, and Tom painted it too.
ir: (assert (and (e1 paint :tense past :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :obj (m2 fence :det the)) (e2 paint :tense past :subj (m3 Tom :propn) :obj (m4 it :pron :ref m2) :adv too)))
notes: it: Robin and Tom excluded by agreement (human; Tom is also the subject of its clause). Only fence.

text: Sam said that Maria trusted him.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 Sam :propn) :comp (e2 trust :tense past :subj (m2 Maria :propn) :obj (m3 he :pron :ref m1))))
notes: him: Maria excluded by binding (subject of the pronoun's own clause) and by agreement (feminine). Sam (unknown gender) is in the higher clause, so allowed.

text: The man who fixed the car said that it was ready.
ir: (assert (e1 say :tense past :subj (m1 man :det the :rel (e2 fix :tense past :subj m1 :obj (m2 car :det the))) :comp (e3 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m2) :attr ready)))
notes: it: man excluded by agreement (human). Only car.

text: The doctor examined himself.
ir: (assert (e1 examine :tense past :subj (m1 doctor :det the) :obj (m2 he :pron :refl :ref m1)))
notes: himself: reflexive refers to the subject of its own clause; doctor has unknown gender, so compatible.

text: They opened the window quietly.
ir: (assert (e1 open :tense past :subj (m1 they :pron :ref none) :obj (m2 window :det the) :adv quietly))
notes: they: window excluded by number (singular). No candidate: :ref none.

text: It snowed yesterday.
ir: (assert (e1 snow :tense past :subj (m1 it :pron :ref none) :adv yesterday))
notes: Weather/expletive it: no mention in the sentence (yesterday is an adverb atom). :ref none.

text: The vase didn't fit on the shelf because it was too wide.
ir: (assert (e1 fit :tense past :pol neg :subj (m1 vase :det the) :obl-on (m2 shelf :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr (wide :adv too))))
notes: it: vase and shelf are both singular non-human; nothing excluded. World knowledge needed (a too-wide vase does not fit; a too-wide shelf is not a reason).

text: Tom visited Bill because he was lonely.
ir: (assert (e1 visit :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obj (m2 Bill :propn) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr lonely)))
notes: he: Tom and Bill are both masculine singular names in the main clause; binding does not apply across the because-clause. Either can be the lonely one.

text: The lawyer interrupted the judge because she was impatient.
ir: (assert (e1 interrupt :tense past :subj (m1 lawyer :det the) :obj (m2 judge :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr impatient)))
notes: she: lawyer and judge both have unknown gender, so both are compatible. Nothing excluded.

text: Maria thanked Anna because she had helped with the move.
ir: (assert (e1 thank :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 Anna :propn) :cause (e2 help :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obl-with (m4 move :det the))))
notes: she: Maria and Anna both feminine. move excluded (non-human, and in the pronoun's own clause).

text: The cat ignored the dog because it was sleeping.
ir: (assert (e1 ignore :tense past :subj (m1 cat :det the) :obj (m2 dog :det the) :cause (e2 sleep :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2))))
notes: it: cat and dog both singular non-human.

text: The soldiers fired at the rebels because they were attacking the village.
ir: (assert (e1 fire :tense past :subj (m1 soldier :det the :num pl) :obl-at (m2 rebel :det the :num pl) :cause (e2 attack :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m4 village :det the))))
notes: they: village excluded (singular). soldiers and rebels both plural.

text: The bottle fell off the table because it was wobbly.
ir: (assert (e1 fall :tense past :subj (m1 bottle :det the) :obl-off (m2 table :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr wobbly)))
notes: it: bottle and table both singular non-human.

text: John lent Peter money because he was broke.
ir: (assert (e1 lend :tense past :subj (m1 John :propn) :iobj (m2 Peter :propn) :obj (m3 money) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m4 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr broke)))
notes: he: money excluded (non-human). John and Peter both masculine.

text: The officers arrested the protesters because they were violent.
ir: (assert (e1 arrest :tense past :subj (m1 officer :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 protester :det the :num pl) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr violent)))
notes: they: both plural; nothing excluded.

text: The ball broke the window because it was heavy.
ir: (assert (e1 break :tense past :subj (m1 ball :det the) :obj (m2 window :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr heavy)))
notes: it: ball and window both singular non-human.

text: Maria couldn't lift her daughter because she was too weak.
ir: (assert (e1 lift :mod could :pol neg :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 daughter :poss (m3 she :pron :ref m1)) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m4 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr (weak :adv too))))
notes: she (m4): Maria and daughter both feminine. her (m3): daughter excluded because it contains the pronoun, so only Maria (possessive exempt from binding). Other pronouns are not listed as antecedents (spec silent; generator convention).

text: The frog ate the beetle because it was hungry.
ir: (assert (e1 eat :tense past :subj (m1 frog :det the) :obj (m2 beetle :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr hungry)))
notes: it: frog and beetle both singular non-human.

text: Tom beat Jack at chess because he had practiced.
ir: (assert (e1 beat :tense past :subj (m1 Tom :propn) :obj (m2 Jack :propn) :obl-at (m3 chess) :cause (e2 practice :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m4 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2))))
notes: he: chess excluded (non-human). Tom and Jack both masculine.

text: The truck passed the bus because it was slow.
ir: (assert (e1 pass :tense past :subj (m1 truck :det the) :obj (m2 bus :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr slow)))
notes: it: truck and bus both singular non-human.

text: The engineers told the managers that they had made a mistake.
ir: (assert (e1 tell :tense past :subj (m1 engineer :det the :num pl) :iobj (m2 manager :det the :num pl) :comp (e2 make :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m4 mistake :det a))))
notes: they: mistake excluded (singular). Both plural groups possible. Addressee of tell + that-clause annotated :iobj (spec silent).

text: Sarah envied Emily because she was popular.
ir: (assert (e1 envy :tense past :subj (m1 Sarah :propn) :obj (m2 Emily :propn) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr popular)))
notes: she: both feminine names; nothing excluded.

text: The student asked the professor a question because he was confused.
ir: (assert (e1 ask :tense past :subj (m1 student :det the) :iobj (m2 professor :det the) :obj (m3 question :det a) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m4 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr confused)))
notes: he: question excluded (non-human). student and professor have unknown gender, both compatible.

text: The statue slid off the pedestal because it was slippery.
ir: (assert (e1 slide :tense past :subj (m1 statue :det the) :obl-off (m2 pedestal :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr slippery)))
notes: it: statue and pedestal both singular non-human.

text: The dog chased the cat until it was tired.
ir: (assert (e1 chase :tense past :subj (m1 dog :det the) :obj (m2 cat :det the) :until (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr tired)))
notes: it: dog and cat both singular non-human.

text: The parents visited the children because they missed them.
ir: (assert (e1 visit :tense past :subj (m1 parent :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 child :det the :num pl) :cause (e2 miss :tense past :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m4 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2))))
notes: they (m3) and them (m4): parents and children both plural. them cannot be m3 by binding (subject of its own clause); pronouns are not listed as antecedents (spec silent). Grammar does not force them and they apart from the two groups, so both list both.

text: Maria poured water from the jug into the glass until it was full.
ir: (assert (e1 pour :tense past :subj (m1 Maria :propn) :obj (m2 water) :obl-from (m3 jug :det the) :obl-into (m4 glass :det the) :until (e2 be :tense past :subj (m5 it :pron :ref m2 :ref m3 :ref m4) :attr full)))
notes: it: Maria excluded (human). water (mass, singular non-human), jug and glass are all grammatically possible.

text: The tourists photographed the monkeys while they were eating.
ir: (assert (e1 photograph :tense past :subj (m1 tourist :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 monkey :det the :num pl) :while (e2 eat :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2))))
notes: they: both plural.

text: Paul tried to call George, but he wasn't available.
ir: (assert (but (e1 try :tense past :subj (m1 Paul :propn) :xcomp (e2 call :obj (m2 George :propn))) (e3 be :tense past :pol neg :subj (m3 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr available)))
notes: he: Paul and George both masculine and in a different clause.

text: The knife couldn't cut the bread because it was too dull.
ir: (assert (e1 cut :mod could :pol neg :subj (m1 knife :det the) :obj (m2 bread :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr (dull :adv too))))
notes: it: knife and bread both singular non-human.

text: Kate gave Lisa her old bicycle because she didn't want it.
ir: (assert (e1 give :tense past :subj (m1 Kate :propn) :iobj (m2 Lisa :propn) :obj (m3 bicycle :poss (m4 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :adj old) :cause (e2 want :tense past :pol neg :subj (m5 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m6 it :pron :ref m3))))
notes: her (m4): possessive, exempt from binding, so Kate and Lisa both possible; bicycle contains it. she (m5): Kate, Lisa. it (m6): Kate/Lisa excluded (human); only bicycle. Pronouns not listed as antecedents.

text: Robin waved at Alex because he was leaving.
ir: (assert (e1 wave :tense past :subj (m1 Robin :propn) :obl-at (m2 Alex :propn) :cause (e2 leave :tense past :aspect prog :subj (m3 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2))))
notes: he: Robin and Alex both unknown gender, compatible with he.

text: The waiter ignored the customer because he was rude.
ir: (assert (e1 ignore :tense past :subj (m1 waiter :det the) :obj (m2 customer :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 he :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr rude)))
notes: he: waiter (masculine) and customer (unknown gender) both compatible.

text: The doctor phoned the patient because she had received the results.
ir: (assert (e1 phone :tense past :subj (m1 doctor :det the) :obj (m2 patient :det the) :cause (e2 receive :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 she :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m4 result :det the :num pl))))
notes: she: results excluded (plural, non-human). doctor and patient have unknown gender.

text: The coaches criticized the players because they had lost the match.
ir: (assert (e1 criticize :tense past :subj (m1 coach :det the :num pl) :obj (m2 player :det the :num pl) :cause (e2 lose :tense past :aspect perf :subj (m3 they :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :obj (m4 match :det the))))
notes: they: match excluded (singular). Both plural groups possible.

text: The rope couldn't hold the anchor because it was too heavy.
ir: (assert (e1 hold :mod could :pol neg :subj (m1 rope :det the) :obj (m2 anchor :det the) :cause (e2 be :tense past :subj (m3 it :pron :ref m1 :ref m2) :attr (heavy :adv too))))
notes: it: rope and anchor both singular non-human.
